Q5217.reason: Under UCC §2-207, the confirmation formed a contract on the original terms, while the materially altering loading charge did not become part of the contract.

Q6156.reason: The deposition is inadmissible hearsay because the company lacked a similar motive to develop the testimony in the earlier wrongful-termination action.

Q8413.reason: The Court held that state immunity prevailed over Al-Adsani’s Article 6 right of access to a court.
